title: Unchecked Low-level Call when buying tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In the `_buyGovernanceTokenERC20DAO()` and `_buyGovernanceTokenERC721DAO()` functions, the success of low-level calls to both `gnosisAddress` and `ownerAddress` is not verified. This oversight means that when these calls fail, the failure will go unnoticed, leaving the funds in the factory without being distributed to `gnosisAddress` or `ownerAddress` .This results in neither party receiving their share of the payment.  ## Recommendations  Check the return value of the low-level calls within both `_buyGovernanceTokenERC20DAO()
